sentences.text: This is a petition filed u/s 439(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure Code seeking cancellation of the bail order dated 26.08.2022 passed by 7 th Addl.

Sessions Judge, Durg, District Durg passed in Crime No.728/2022 registered at P.S. Supela (Police Chowki Smritinagar), District Durg for the offence u/s 420, 34 of IPC whereby the anticipatory bail has been granted to respondents 2 & 3.
Since no representation is made on behalf of the petitioner despite repeated call, this Court is left with no other way except to dismiss the petition for want of prosecution.
Consequently, this petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.
